t: Metal and acrylic construction with brushed chrome finish. Fits 25mm hole. Adjustable legs ensure tight fit. The Coldstrip LED Deck Kit offers a sleek, contemporary, waterproof design, making this unit a must for decking, walkways and other outdoor areas. Combined with exceptionally low power consumption, this 20-head pack is enough to complement the largest of decks. Standard UK 3-pin plug fits into outdoor-rated mains sockets. Can be hard-wired into mains connection by removing plug. Easy to fit 'plug and play' connection system. 15m extension cable allows long distances to be reached.
